_comment: The Phasor / FRET window (Qt: ndxplorer/ui/phasor_panel.py PhasorControlPanel, opened by the 'ChiSurf Phasor' toolbar). The geometry is computed by ChiSurf over app.chisurf_rpc.

sections.label: Frequency (MHz)
sections.description: Modulation frequency for the phasor geometry and the apparent lifetimes.

sections.label: Harmonic
sections.description: Harmonic number; the effective frequency is frequency x harmonic.

sections.label: Lifetimes (ns)
sections.description: Comma-separated reference lifetimes (ns) for the grid and the ticks.

sections.label: Donor τ0 (ns)
sections.description: Donor-only lifetime for the FRET trajectory (τ_DA = τ_D0·(1−E)).

sections.label: Universal semicircle
sections.description: The universal semicircle of single-exponential decays.

sections.label: Iso-lifetime grid
sections.description: Lines of constant apparent lifetime through the reference lifetimes.

sections.label: Lifetime ticks
sections.description: The reference lifetimes marked on the semicircle.

sections.label: Polar grid
sections.description: Circles of constant modulation and rays of constant phase.

sections.label: FRET trajectory
sections.description: The donor's phasor as FRET quenches it, from donor τ0.

buttons.label: Draw overlays
buttons.description: Draw the checked sets on the map; the axes must be g and s.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Remove the phasor overlays and FRET lines from the map.

sections.label: Model
sections.description: The FRET component model the line is computed with.

sections.label: Sweep param
sections.description: The model parameter swept along the FRET line.

buttons.label: Draw FRET line
buttons.description: Compute the FRET line in ChiSurf and draw it on the map.

buttons.label: τ φ/M columns
buttons.description: Compute τ_φ and τ_M from the g and s columns and add them as columns.
